title: Add API Overview page (page 812)
summary: A new admin page shows all available APIs (pages and queries) from all publishers in the environment, with clickable URLs to test endpoints before external integration.
key_points: New page 812 API Overview displays both API pages and API queries across all publishers
Includes columns for API details like Name, Type, Publisher, Entity, Version, and clickable API URL
Built-in views filter by API type, Microsoft vs custom APIs, and API version 2.0
Internal temporary buffer table 812 supports the page
Integration test validates listing completeness and correct metadata rendering
quote: shows all APIs available in the environment - both API pages and API queries - across all publishers
